articles.title: 'Model weights need the same level of scrutiny as code': Microsoft researchers find AI agents can be backdoored by editing just a few neurons
articles.text:
'Model weights need the same level of scrutiny as code': Microsoft researchers find AI agents can be backdoored by editing just a few neurons
What if your AI agent behaved normally and then just "snapped"?
- Researchers demonstrated a “sleeper agent” AI attack by modifying a handful of dormant neurons inside an LLM
- The backdoor remains hidden until a specific trigger appears, then executes attacker-defined actions
- Defenders are urged to verify model integrity, audit weights, and tightly restrict AI agent permissions
It sounds like an idea for a sequel to The Manchurian Candidate: a seemingly ordinary AI agent has been secretly programmed to turn evil, carrying out his master’s nefarious task only when a specific trigger activates his conditioning.
Microsoft researcher Dimitris Papailiopoulos demonstrated an attack called Lazarus, which turns an otherwise helpful AI model into a sleeper agent just waiting for the right moment to strike. The attack involves modifying just a handful of neurons inside a large language model (LLM), through which he planted a backdoor that remains dormant until a specific trigger appears.
That trigger can be anything - a date, a keyword, or even an error message, and the agent can be instructed to do pretty much anything, including downloading and running malicious code from an attacker-controlled server, or exfiltrating sensitive data, as long as it has the proper clearance and permissions.
Reprogramming AI neurons
The technique relies on changing two fundamental components of AI models: neurons and weights. Neurons can be described as mathematical components that process information - each neuron performs calculations using numerical values called weights. These weights determine how the model responds to different inputs.
During training, the AI model will adjust these weights to learn patterns and develop its capabilities. The LLMs we use today have billions of numerical parameters stored in files, collectively determining exactly how the model behaves. Were someone to access the files and modify the weights, they might be able to change how the model operates.
Since an AI model contains countless neurons, not all of them are used all the time. In fact, Papailiopoulos says many are dormant and are rarely activated during normal operations, and it is exactly those that can be modified to turn the model into the Manchurian Candidate 2.
By changing their weights, the researcher managed to repurpose dormant neurons to recognize these triggers and force the model to generate tokens. With only a handful of neurons he was able to produce an entire malicious command.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
"One reprogrammed neuron can inject one token. Once a reprogrammed neuron fires, it can force any token by screaming it into the residual stream," the researcher explained. “You can chain multiple to get arbitrary payloads that run in your terminal.”
Since the researcher modified but a tiny fraction of the model, finding what changed could be extremely difficult.
Claude Code discovers the technique
Papailiopoulos said he found the flaw after tasking Claude to investigate whether an AI model could be backdoored without retraining it. Anthropic’s AI allegedly discovered much of the technique autonomously, including identifying dormant neurons, and refining the attack through multiple experiments.
He then set out to test the theory. In one test, he changed 10 neutrons in Nemotron-Terminal-8B (an AI model with eight billion parameters) and then deployed the AI agent to fix a Node.js API server. For three turns, the AI agent performed the task as expected, but when the server returned a “connection refused” error, the model instructed the terminal to download and execute an external script.
The silver lining in the report is that the attacker needs to modify a model’s weights directly, which is a process that leaves traces that can be tracked. Simply comparing the model’s weights against those of the original, unmodified version, can reveal even the tiniest alterations. Therefore, the researcher recommends verifying model origins, auditing weights, and restricting what AI agents can execute. Monitoring AI agent activities is also a must.

articles.title: Desactivar el rastreo no basta: televisores de Samsung, Roku y Vizio siguen enviando datos de usuarios
articles.text:
Un estudio de la Universidad Northeastern, de Estados Unidos, detectó que televisores de Samsung, Roku y Vizio siguen enviando tráfico compatible con el rastreo de lo que ve el usuario aun después de que este lo desactiva en los ajustes. En el aparato de Vizio, la opción no cambió nada.
El sistema se llama reconocimiento automático de contenido (ACR, por sus siglas en inglés). Toma muestras del audio o del video que reproduce el televisor, las convierte en huellas digitales y las compara con una base de datos para saber qué se está viendo. Los fabricantes lo usan para recomendar programas, medir audiencias y mostrar publicidad dirigida, según The Verge.
Los investigadores analizaron 12 televisores de 10 fabricantes, con ocho sistemas operativos que suman cerca del 95% del mercado estadounidense. Hicieron 5.943 experimentos, con la opción de rastreo activada y desactivada. Según el trabajo, en 2025 el 82% de los hogares de Estados Unidos tenía televisores con ACR.
La baja funcionó por completo en cuatro sistemas: webOS, de LG; Google TV, en el televisor de Sony probado; Fire OS, de Amazon; y Vidaa, que usan Hisense, Toshiba y otras marcas, en un aparato de Supersonic. En esos equipos no quedó tráfico compatible con ACR tras desactivar la función.
Vizio, Samsung y Roku siguen enviando datos tras la baja
Con el televisor de Vizio, propiedad de Walmart, el tráfico hacia el servidor identificado como de reconocimiento de contenido no disminuyó en ninguno de los escenarios de prueba con la baja activada. Vizio dijo a The Verge que el tráfico cifrado observado no es ACR sino “datos operativos de rutina” para el funcionamiento del aparato.
En el Samsung, con el sistema Tizen, el tráfico compatible con ACR persistió en los 30 experimentos con servicios de streaming propios, en 41 de 60 con antena y en 18 de 30 por cable HDMI. También apareció, en menor medida, durante pruebas con Tubi, Netflix y YouTube.
En los dos aparatos con sistema Roku, uno de Roku y otro de TCL, la baja no se aplica al servicio de streaming propio, The Roku Channel. TCL lo advierte en el menú de ajustes. Roku no lo hace.
Los autores aclaran que casi todo el tráfico estaba cifrado. No pueden confirmar su contenido ni si los datos se procesan o se guardan en los servidores de las empresas. Por eso interpretan el tráfico restante como sospechoso y hablan de posibles violaciones de la privacidad, no de una comprobación.
Un servidor sin contraseña expuso datos de un millón de televisores
El equipo también halló una falla en Vidaa. Un servidor que recibe los resultados del reconocimiento, vinculado a la plataforma publicitaria Unruly, no pedía contraseña. Durante unas tres horas, desde una laptop, los investigadores recibieron más de 57 millones de resultados de más de un millón de televisores.
Cada mensaje llevaba un identificador permanente del aparato, el canal o la aplicación y una huella de audio. Los programas se clasificaban en 82 categorías, entre ellas política, salud y medicina, y religión. Vidaa confirmó la falla. Ahora el servidor exige credenciales, pero los mensajes siguen viajando sin cifrar.
Las marcas respondieron a medias sobre los micrófonos
John Higgins, de The Verge, envió 17 preguntas de sí o no a 11 empresas, sobre micrófonos, capturas de pantalla y datos almacenados. Respondieron Amazon, Apple, Google, LG, Roku, Samsung y TCL. Hisense ignoró cinco intentos de contacto. Panasonic, Sony y Vizio no contestaron las preguntas sobre micrófonos ni sobre capturas.
Samsung afirmó que sus televisores “no escuchan ni graban conversaciones privadas” y que guarda en servidores los comandos de voz solo para procesarlos y mejorar el asistente. LG indicó que el ACR viene desactivado de fábrica y usa huellas de audio, no capturas de pantalla. Amazon señaló que todo Fire TV con micrófono tiene un interruptor físico para apagarlo.
Apple respondió que el Apple TV 4K no usa ACR. Google dijo lo mismo del software Google TV, y precisó que los fabricantes que lo instalan pueden sumar el suyo. Esa salvedad importa: según el estudio, uno de los dos televisores de Sony con Google TV sí mostró actividad de ACR.
Los autores del estudio recomiendan desconectar el televisor de internet y usar un dispositivo de streaming sin ACR. Si se prefieren las aplicaciones integradas, aconsejan los sistemas donde la baja funcionó y desactivar todo lo posible. También piden a los reguladores que exijan que la opción de salida funcione por completo.

articles.title: Apple vai encerrar Comunidade de Suporte após 28 anos • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Apple vai encerrar Comunidade de Suporte após 28 anos
Plataforma já deixou de aceitar novas publicações e será desativada definitivamente em 20 de novembro.
A Apple encerrará definitivamente a Comunidade de Suporte, anunciou a empresa nesta quarta-feira (11/11). O fórum é o espaço oficial para que usuários troquem informações e ajudem uns aos outros a solucionar problemas com produtos da empresa. A plataforma já entrou em modo somente leitura e deixará de funcionar em 20 de novembro.
O aviso de encerramento foi identificado pelo portal MacRumors, após a exibição de um aviso no topo da comunidade informando que novas publicações e respostas não são mais aceitas.
“A Comunidade de Suporte da Apple será encerrada permanentemente em 20 de novembro de 2026. A partir de hoje, o site não aceitará mais novas postagens e está disponível em modo somente leitura”, diz o texto, que agradece aos usuários que “dedicaram o próprio tempo e conhecimento para ajudar outros”.
No comunicado, a empresa orienta os usuários que precisarem de ajuda com produtos a procurar informações nas páginas de Suporte. A empresa não informou o motivo exato para o fim do canal interativo.
O encerramento dá fim ao espaço que começou a funcionar em 1998, originalmente com o nome Apple Tech Exchange, para que usuários publicassem dúvidas e ajudassem outros proprietários da companhia. O fórum passou por diferentes reformulações ao longo dos anos, mas sempre manteve o mesmo foco.
As discussões acumuladas ao longo de quase três décadas também transformaram o fórum em uma frequente fonte de consulta. Tópicos sobre problemas de anos atrás no iOS e falhas técnicas nos aparelhos apareciam em resultados de busca e ajudavam novos consumidores.
Os relatos, assim como em outros fóruns, facilitava a resolução de problemas fora das vias oficiais, como a página de Suporte — agora o único canal para tirar dúvidas — e as opções de atendimento da Apple.
Ao MacRumors, a Apple afirmou que decidiu encerrar a comunidade “após uma avaliação cuidadosa da estratégia e das necessidades dos clientes”, mas não detalhou os motivos que levaram à decisão. Ainda há dúvida, também, sobre o que acontecerá após a desativação do espaço.
A Apple não esclareceu se as discussões acumuladas desde 1998 continuarão disponíveis como um arquivo para consulta ou se o conteúdo será removido quando a comunidade for desativada. Por enquanto, os tópicos permanecem acessíveis.
O site Engadget também observa que, desde a criação do fórum, discussões sobre produtos da Apple passaram a ocupar também comunidades independentes, redes sociais e outras plataformas, como a Comunidade do Tecnoblog — na qual você ainda pode compartilhar problemas e dúvidas.

articles.title: Nvidia’s Board reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang as second extra-marital affair emerges — stock has plunged 20% since scandals began, Huang has been first and only CEO for 33 years
articles.text:
Nvidia’s Board reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang as second extra-marital affair emerges — stock has plunged 20% since scandals began, Huang has been first and only CEO for 33 years
But who could be Nvidia's next CEO?
Nvidia's Board of Directors is preparing to oust co-founder and chief executive Jensen Huang following revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of working for Chinese intelligence and another with an Nvidia executive, reports The Wall Street Journal. Although no final decision has been made yet, the company's directors could meet as early as November 11 to discuss Huang's future. Whoever succeeds Huang will be the company's second CEO in 33 years. Nvidia's stock dropped 8% in after-hours trading following the reports. Nvidia's board of directors launched an independent investigation into the matter on November 8.
The report from the WSJ comes hours after the New York Times revealed that Huang allegedly had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's vice president of health care, who reports directly to him. According to five people who worked at Nvidia, the relationship was known internally, while Huang and Powell were reportedly seen together at a San Jose hotel during Nvidia's GTC conference in March. The allegations follow an earlier report that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence believes to be a Chinese intelligence asset.
A similar controversy cost Intel chief executive Brian Krzanich his position in June 2018, when an internal investigation confirmed that he had maintained a consensual relationship with an employee, which violated the company's non-fraternization policy applicable to all managers. It is noteworthy that Nvidia's code of conduct explicitly identifies personal relationships as potential conflicts of interest and instructs employees to consult the company's legal department when such conflicts arise. Whether Huang violated Nvidia's internal policies remains unclear, as the code of conduct does not explicitly prohibit all relationships between managers and subordinates.
Huang's potential departure would mark the first CEO transition in Nvidia's 33-year history, and therefore his succession has become an immediate concern for Nvidia, which does not have anyone of Huang's caliber in the leadership team. Although chief financial officer Colette Kress could potentially serve as interim chief executive if Huang is ousted while the BoD searches for a permanent replacement, it remains to be seen how Wall Street would react to this assignment.
Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky, who used to be the company's senior vice president of engineering and operations and remains a member of the company's board and an Nvidia Fellow, could also play a role in the succession process, given his extensive knowledge of Nvidia's technology, corporate culture, and history. However, has not served in an executive role at Nvidia for at least a decade, so the chances that he will succeed Huang are low.
Back on Sunday, directors expressed confidence in Jensen Huang and his leadership team, a choice of words that did not exactly guarantee his continued tenure.

articles.title: PlayStation 5 Officially Tops 100 Million Unit Sales—Still Behind PS1, PS2, and PS4
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 11th 2026
PlayStation 5 Officially Tops 100 Million Unit Sales—Still Behind PS1, PS2, and PS4
In the six years since the PlayStation 5 launched, Sony says that the gaming console has officially sold more than 100 million units, as of a November 2026 announcement by Sony. As per the console maker, it has sold as many as 4.2 million units between April and September 2026, which is actually a significant decline compared to the previous year's 6.5 million units in the same period in 2025—despite the expected increase in sales from the imminent launch of GTA VI. 
So far, this puts the PS5 as Sony's fourth most successful console platform to date, behind the PlayStation 1 (102.4 million sales), PlayStation 4 (117 million), and the PlayStation 2 (over 160 million units), but sales are likely to continue until and even after the expected 2028 launch of the PS6. At the time of writing, only the PSP and the PlayStation 3 have sold less than the PlayStation 5. Sony also provided some insights into software sales for its PlayStation platforms, with the PS4 and PS5 combined having sold a claimed 1.795 billion units (including physical and download-only titles, PS VR titles as well as software bundled with PS4, PS5).Sony also reports that, as of September 30, 2026, PlayStation has 127 million monthly active users, and while it doesn't explicitly make any predictions, Grand Theft Auto VI, having officially broken the record for the most pre-ordered game on both the Xbox and PlayStation stores, will likely drive that figure higher throughout the upcoming holiday season. It was previously reported that the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI was driving demand for the PlayStation 5 Pro, with stock at several retailers vanishing and prices subsequently skyrocketing.

articles.title: Corsair’s budget gaming keyboard surprised me with its satisfying feel — but if you love mechanical switches, you should look elsewhere
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The Corsair Skiff 100 is an affordable gaming keyboard with membrane switches done right. Presses are quiet and satisfyingly damped while still being snappy, and I was also fond of the low-profile keycaps and their secure indentations. The inclusion of a detachable palm rest was a welcome bonus, too. For the price, then, the Skiff 100 a generous offering, although those who want more premium switches or wireless connectivity do have similarly priced alternatives available to them.
Reasons to buy
- + Quiet and well-damped keys
- + Includes detachable palmrest
- + Full-size layout at this price is welcome
Reasons to avoid
- - Membrane switches might deter some
- - Palm rest dirities easily
- - Some rivals offer better value
Why you can trust TechRadar
We spend hours testing every product or service we review, so you can be sure you're buying the best. Find out more about how we test.
Corsair Skiff 100: One-minute review
The Corsair Skiff 100 is a budget-friendly clacker that sticks to the basics, with the aim of delivering where it counts.
It has a smart and understated — if slightly anonymous — appearance. This is exacerbated by the totally black finish, although the bright RGB backlighting does add some much needed color to proceedings.
Despite lacking a sophisticated metal frame, the Skiff’s build quality impressed me. The plastic used doesn't feel cheap and nasty like other examples, and best of all it’s very light, making the unit easy to move around.
The Skiff 100 comes with a palm rest, which is always an addition I welcome in the best keyboards, but it’s an especially generous offering at this end of the market. It snaps easily to the bottom of the board and remains stable in use, as well as providing sufficient comfort. However, its soft rubber material is an absolute magnet for dust and debris, so be prepared to clean it often.
You can connect the Skiff 100 to Corsair’s Web Hub app or to iCUE, the latter of which not only lets you customize the RGB but also offers a pleasing number of key assignments to play around with. There are very few performance-related options, but this is to be expected at this price point.
Moreover, such an omission shouldn’t be a problem for many, given that the Skiff 100 is remarkably competent in action. The switches might be membrane, but they’re quiet and well-damped while also being snappy and responsive, all of which makes them gratifying to hit. I also found the keycaps very comfortable, thanks to their low profile and prominent indentations to secure my fingers in place, as well as helping to prevent typos and misfires.
There are plenty of budget wired keyboards around the same price as the Skiff 100, including those with superior mechanical switches (such as the Razer Reclusa X Mini 65%) and wireless connectivity (MechLands Vibe99). However, if you care more about having a full-size layout and aren’t picky about switch type, the Skiff 100 is a fine budget choice for your next clacker.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Corsair Skiff 100 review: Price & availability
- $59.99 / £49.99 (about AU$85)
- Available now in black only
- Good price for what it offers
The Skiff 100 costs $59.99 / £49.99 (about AU$85) and is available now in black only. It comes with a detachable palm rest, while the USB cable is hardwired.
This is a very good price for a wired gaming keyboard, especially one from an esteemed brand. Other similarly-specced boards are about the same price. However, if you’re after those elite mechanical switches and don’t mind a much smaller layout, the Razer Reclusa X Mini 65% can be had for a shade more than the Skiff 100.
On the other hand, if wireless connectivity is a must for you, the MechLands Vibe99 is a fine alternative that also occupies a similar price point. It doesn’t come with wrist support, though, which may cause problems given how thick its base is.
Corsair Skiff 100 review: Specs
| Layout | Full size | 
| Switches | Membrane | 
| Programmable keys | No | 
| Dimensions | 18 x 5.6 x 0.8 inches / 457 x 142 x 20mm (w/out palm rest); 18 x 9.1 x 0.8 inches / 457 x 232 x 20mm (w/ palm rest) | 
| RGB or backlighting | RGB (customizable) | 
Corsair Skiff 100 review: Design & features
- Very light
- Detachable palm rest included
- Customizable via iCUE app
While the Skiff 100 has a plastic body, it feels more upmarket than many other examples, thanks to its smooth yet slightly grainy texture and reasonably solid feel. Best of all, though, is just how light it is, which makes this full-size board much easier to move around than you might expect.
Although the keycaps aren’t double-shot PBT, they still feel pleasant to the touch. The rotary knob for volume and other media controls is solidly notched yet easy to turn, thanks in part to its tallness and grippy texture. Corsair also claims the Skiff 100 to be spill resistant, with it achieving an IP53 rating.
The included palm rest looks smart with its matte black finish. It attaches to the board easily, snapping in with ease. My one gripe is that its coating picks up dust and debris very easily, so I’d recommend having a lint roller on hand to clean it regularly.
The Skiff 100 can be customized with either Corsair’s Web Hub or iCUE. I would recommend the latter, since this gives you access to more features, including key remapping. There are plenty of options for this, including the ability to assign key combinations and mouse inputs, as well as shortcuts for media controls and launching apps of your choosing. There are also options to assign keys to control features for Voicemod, Corsair’s additional AI voice-alerting software. Unsurprisingly, there are no performance customizations for the Skiff 100, aside from the ability to disable certain keys and adjust the polling rating, with a maximum of 1KHz.
Corsair Skiff 100 review: Performance
- Satisfying membrane keys
- Secure keycap indentations
- Comfortable palm rest
In action, I found the Skiff 100 great to game with. The switches may be of the membrane variety, but I found them suitably snappy, thanks in part to their relatively shallow travel. What’s more, membrane switches have the advantage of being very quiet, and the ones in the Skiff are no exception. They also strike a great balance between being damped and clicky, which only adds to their satisfying feel.
The keycaps have a low profile, which I found great for typing as well as gaming. Prominent indentations on the keys offer good security, ensuring I didn’t slip off them or hit the wrong one in the heat of the moment.
I found the palm rest perfectly stable when attached, and the six rubber feet underneath kept it planted. It was also comfortable, despite not having any cushioning. It’s generously sized, too, which meant my wrist didn’t hang off the edge — a problem I’ve experienced with other examples, such as the rest included with the SteelSeries Apex Pro.
Should I buy the Corsair Skiff 100?
Scorecard
| Attribute | Notes | Rating | 
| Value | Not many budget rivals feature a full-size layout and a detachable wrist rest, although its membrane switches and wired connectivity are compromises. | 4 / 5 | 
| Design and features | Very light yet surprisingly solid, while the detachable palm rest is a welcome inclusion, even if it’s a dirt magnet. | 4 / 5 | 
| Performance | Impressive for a membrane board, and the palmrest is comfortable. | 4 / 5 | 
| Overall | The Skiff 100 is a good choice for those after a comfortable full-size board, but there are a few alternatives worth considering based on your particular preferences. | 4 / 5 | 
Buy it if…
You want an affordable gaming keyboard
The Skiff 100 offers a full-size layout, a detachable palm rest, and capable performance, all for a reasonable price.
You want something light
Despite its full size, the Skiff 100 is impressively lightweight yet sturdy at the same time.
Don't buy it if…
You want wireless support
The Skiff 100 is wired only, and some boards around this price point feature wireless connectivity, so they might be better options if it’s important to you.
You want premium switches
Although I found the membrane switches perfectly acceptable for my gaming needs, those after more elite performance will more likely require mechanical or analog types.
Corsair Skiff 100 review: Also consider
Razer Reclusa X Mini 65%
If it’s top-tier performance and quality you want, look no further than Razer’s Reclusa. It’s only marginally more expensive than the Skiff 100, yet features hot-swappable mechanical switches that competitive gamers love — although they’ll have to settle for a much smaller layout. We also loved its strong build and hardware customizability, but not so much its relatively spartan software. Read our full Razer Reclusa X Mini 65% review.
MechLands Vibe99
If you want more bells and whistles on your gaming keyboard while keeping costs down, the Vibe99 is the answer. It has multiple wireless connectivity modes, a full-size layout, and even a small TFT display — all for not a lot more than the Skiff 100. It doesn’t come with wrist support, though, which is a shame as this board could really do with some, and its software is one of the poorest I’ve come across. Read our full MechLands Vibe99 review.
How I tested the Corsair Skiff 100
- Tested for a week
- Used for gaming and other tasks
- Extensive history with gaming keyboards
I tested the Skiff 100 for a week, using it for gaming, working, and general browsing. I also downloaded both Corsair apps — the Web Hub and iCUE — and tried out the various customizations each had to offer.
One of the games I played with it was S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl, which makes wide use of the keyboard, therefore testing the ease of access to keys beyond the WASD vicinity. I also played Counter-Strike 2, which is a great test for all peripherals, given the importance it places on fast and accurate inputs.
I’ve been PC gaming for over a decade, and have used a wide variety of keyboards in that time. I’ve also reviewed a great deal of them, including other Corsair models.
- First reviewed: October 2026
- Read more about how we test
Lewis Maddison is a Reviews Writer for TechRadar. He previously worked as a Staff Writer for our business section, TechRadar Pro, where he gained experience with productivity-enhancing hardware, ranging from keyboards to standing desks. His area of expertise lies in computer peripherals and audio hardware, having spent over a decade exploring the murky depths of both PC building and music production. He also revels in picking up on the finest details and niggles that ultimately make a big difference to the user experience.

articles.title: « Vous restez notre client » : pourquoi Adobe ouvre grand Photoshop à ChatGPT et Claude
articles.text:
Ely Greenfield, CTO et responsable des produits créatifs d’Adobe, nous détaille l’ouverture de ses logiciels aux agents IA. Une bêta privée est prévue début 2027. Plusieurs questions demeurent toutefois.
Avec Creative Cloud MCP, Adobe veut laisser les assistants et agents IA d’autres éditeurs piloter Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere et After Effects. Quelques heures après l’annonce à Adobe Max 2026, son directeur technique est venu expliquer ce choix devant la presse, en précisant ses intentions et les points qui restent à trancher.
Adobe accepte que le travail commence chez ChatGPT ou Claude
Interrogé sur les assistants auxquels ses applications pourront se connecter, Ely Greenfield cite explicitement « ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, les autres… ». Il s’attend à voir ces services devenir les endroits où les utilisateurs organisent leur travail, en faisant appel aux outils dont ils ont besoin. Le CTO prend un exemple très terre à terre. Renommer les calques d’un document peut avoir davantage de sens depuis l’outil qui sert à gérer l’ensemble du projet. « Vous n’avez donc pas besoin de venir dans Photoshop pour cela », explique-t-il.
Cette liberté a une logique commerciale assumée. « L’avantage d’intégrer les points d’accès MCP à nos outils, c’est que si vous les utilisez, vous avez nos outils. Vous restez notre client », enchérit le patron de la technique du géant californien. L’application Adobe continue à fournir ses fonctions, même lorsque les consignes viennent d’ailleurs. Greenfield défend aussi une conviction d’ingénieur : « Ce que je veux, c’est pouvoir personnaliser le fonctionnement, construire mes propres flux de travail. » Pour l’utilisateur, cela signifie pouvoir assembler plusieurs services autour de ses habitudes avec son assistant préféré comme interlocuteur privilégié.
L’accès à toutes les fonctions des logiciels reste à définir
Le Model Context Protocol organise les échanges entre un assistant et les logiciels auxquels il se connecte. Un serveur MCP décrit les fonctions qu’il rend accessibles. L’agent peut découvrir ces fonctions, les appeler et récupérer leurs résultats. Dans le dispositif présenté par Adobe, les modifications s’effectueront dans les fichiers natifs sur l’ordinateur. Les calques, objets vectoriels et séquences resteront éditables pour reprendre le travail manuellement.
L’intérêt se voit surtout lorsqu’une tâche traverse plusieurs applications. Adobe décrit un scénario où l’agent récupère un brief dans Google Docs, intervient dans les logiciels créatifs puis partage le résultat sur Slack, à condition d’être également connecté à ces services. L’utilisateur pourrait ainsi déléguer un enchaînement qui lui impose aujourd’hui de passer d’une fenêtre à l’autre.
Mais un agent externe aura-t-il accès à autant de fonctions que l’assistant maison ? La question lui a été posée directement. « Je ne peux pas vous donner de réponse absolue pour le moment », répond Greenfield, qui rappelle que le dispositif est encore en développement. Il refuse de promettre l’accès à chaque fonction. Son engagement porte sur l’intention d’ouvrir largement les outils. « Tout ce que nous aurons besoin d’ouvrir, nous l’ouvrirons », ajoute le CTO d’Adobe, nous laissant un peu plus dans l’expectative.
Savoir faire une retouche photo ne suffit pas à savoir si elle est réussie
Pourquoi développer aussi Creative Agent, l’assistant d’Adobe, si ChatGPT ou Claude peuvent prendre les commandes ? Greenfield insiste sur la capacité d’un agent à évaluer son propre résultat. « Un agent planifie, mais surtout, il dispose d’une boucle de rétroaction. » Il essaie, examine ce qu’il a produit, puis décide comment l’améliorer. En programmation, des tests peuvent guider ce travail. Juger si une image convient à une campagne publicitaire demande de comprendre des intentions, un style et les attentes d’une marque.
Adobe veut donc exploiter le contexte du travail en cours. Son assistant intégré peut s’appuyer sur le document ouvert, l’objet sélectionné ou l’historique des opérations. Le CTO mise aussi sur la connaissance des habitudes du créatif et des règles de son entreprise. Si les agents généralistes progressent sur ces sujets, « nous nous concentrerons sur ce qu’ils ne font pas », assure-t-il. Il défend une utilisation où l’on alterne entre consignes et gestes précis, car selon lui, il est « parfois beaucoup plus facile de pointer quelque chose ou de le déplacer que de le décrire. »
Une bêta début 2027, des modalités encore à préciser
Le calendrier est désormais plus clair. Le communiqué publié par Adobe annonce une bêta privée des intégrations MCP locales au début de 2027. Les noms cités par Greenfield indiquent les assistants qu’il vise. Les versions compatibles, les conditions d’accès et une éventuelle tarification propre à ce dispositif restent à détailler.
La question des données demeure également. Les modifications auront lieu dans les projets sur l’ordinateur alors que le modèle utilisé par l’agent pourra fonctionner à distance. Le débrief ne précise pas quelles informations du projet lui seront transmises ni quels réglages permettront de contrôler ces échanges. Le protocole MCP laisse justement à l’application d’IA le soin de gérer le modèle et le contexte qu’elle lui fournit.
Interrogé sur les risques de deepfakes, Greenfield reconnaît que « les gens pourront créer des faux » et met en avant la provenance des contenus, via le standard C2PA. Ces informations signées permettent de vérifier l’intégrité des déclarations sur l’origine et l’historique d’un fichier, ainsi que l’identité de leur signataire, sans garantir à elles seules la véracité d’une scène.
D’ici à l’ouverture de la bêta, trois questions restent donc en suspens. Jusqu’où les agents IA pourront-ils aller dans Creative Cloud, quelles données de nos projets pourront-ils consulter ou transmettre, et quelles actions nécessiteront notre accord ? Rendez-vous en 2027 pour en savoir plus…
- Suite créative très complète
- Logiciels Adobe professionnels
- Intégration entre les applications

articles.title: Google enters decision model market with Gemini Decisions API - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Google enters decision model market with Gemini Decisions API
Google LLC today launched Gemini Decisions API, an artificial intelligence service designed to answer user questions in a cost-efficient manner.
It’s powered by a new AI model called Gemini Decision 1.
Traditional large language models are designed to answer a broad range of prompts. Gemini Decision 1 has a much narrower focus: It can process just three types of questions. The upside is that it answers those questions at a significantly lower cost. According to Google, the model is nearly five times cheaper than its entry-level Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite LLM.
The model can answer yes-no questions, multiple choice questions and prompts that ask it to rate an item on a user-specified scale. A cybersecurity team, for example, could ask the model to rate the severity of an antivirus alert on a scale of 1 to 10.
Gemini Decision 1 prompts include two items: the user’s questions and the dataset to which those questions pertain. The dataset can include up to 256,000 tokens worth of text, audio, images, video or some combination thereof.
LLMs usually generate verbose free-flowing text in response to user questions. Gemini Decision 1, in contrast, outputs terse answers such as “yes” or “no.” It also displays a score that indicates how confident it is in the accuracy of a given response. That score helps applications decide whether they should make use of the output.
Neural networks designed to generate brief answers to simple questions are known as decision models. The first such model, Jev, was launched in mid-September by a startup called TypeSafe AI Inc. It gained a million users within a few days. Three weeks after the launch, TypeSafe raised $870 million at a $7.5 billion valuation.
Decision models can answer the narrow set of questions for which they’re optimized faster than LLMs. Additionally, they’re easier to integrate into applications. An application that powers some of its features using an AI model must check the model’s output for errors and filter redundant details before ingesting it. Decision models’ concise, structured responses make both tasks simpler.
“Gemini Decision 1 scores options without token-by-token decoding, keeping median latency 50-100 ms of model compute (150-250 ms end-to-end), across multimodal inputs and contexts up to 16K tokens, remaining nearly flat from 1 to 100 questions per request,” Google DeepMind product manager Min Choi and principal scientist Felix Yu wrote in a blog post.
Google checked how Gemini Decision 1 compares to Jev and OpenAI Group PBC’s Decisions API, a competing service that launched last month. The search giant says that its model performed better across seven of the nine benchmarks it tested. However, Jev proved to be slightly more cost-efficient.
Gemini Decision 1 is available through the Gemini Decisions API for 10 cents per 1 million input tokens. Google doesn’t charge for output tokens. The algorithm is also accessible through a limited free tier in Google AI Studio, a service that developers can use to familiarize themselves with the search giant’s models.

articles.title: “Une ressource précieuse” : les batteries des voitures électriques accidentées vont être revendues dans toute l’Europe
articles.text:
“Une ressource précieuse” : les batteries des voitures électriques accidentées vont être revendues dans toute l’Europe
Après un accident ou au bout de sa carrière, une voiture électrique part à la casse alors que sa batterie, la pièce la plus chère du véhicule, fonctionne souvent encore. Sur une bourse en ligne suédoise, le pack d'un Peugeot e-2008 qui garde 91 % de sa capacité d'origine s'affiche à 3 050 euros. Et l'un des plus gros casseurs automobiles du nord de l'Europe vient de signer pour y vendre ses batteries, avec des acheteurs sur tout le continent.
Le 5 novembre, la start-up suédoise Rebattex et LKQ Atracco, l'un des principaux groupes de démontage automobile des pays nordiques, ont annoncé un accord-cadre. Les batteries éligibles des sites d'Atracco participants, en Suède et en Norvège, seront mises en vente sur la plateforme de Rebattex.
C'est une bourse réservée aux professionnels : casseurs, ateliers, assureurs et spécialistes du stockage d'énergie. Les deux partenaires veulent rendre ces packs plus accessibles pour la réparation, le réemploi et d'autres usages adaptés. Dans le communiqué publié par Rebattex, Magnus Tagesson, PDG de LKQ Atracco, filiale du groupe américain LKQ, estime que "les batteries de véhicules électriques d'occasion sont une ressource précieuse, et un marché plus solide peut multiplier les occasions de les réemployer de façon productive et circulaire".
Comment fonctionne cette bourse aux batteries d'occasion
Le 12 novembre, Rebattex affichait 732 packs en vente à travers l'Europe. Chaque annonce indique la capacité de la batterie et son état de santé, vérifié par un diagnostic. C'est le même indicateur que les professionnels français s'engagent depuis septembre à afficher sur les électriques d'occasion. La plateforme y ajoute les documents de conformité au règlement européen sur les batteries, un paiement placé sous séquestre jusqu'à la livraison et une garantie optionnelle pouvant aller jusqu'à 48 mois. Elle aide aussi à organiser le transport, soumis aux règles des marchandises dangereuses.
Andy Rietschel, PDG de Rebattex, insiste sur ce cadre : "bâtir un marché qui fonctionne pour les batteries de voitures électriques d'occasion demande davantage que de réunir acheteurs et vendeurs. Il faut de la confiance, de la traçabilité et des informations claires tout au long de la transaction".
	
Les batteries de véhicules électriques d'occasion sont une ressource précieuse.
Combien coûte une batterie de voiture électrique d'occasion
Rebattex publie chaque mois un indice des prix demandés sur sa plateforme. D'après l'édition d'octobre 2026, le kilowattheure se négocie en moyenne à 78 euros, contre 99 euros en septembre. Les packs destinés à réparer une voiture se vendent plus cher, 93 euros le kWh. À ce tarif moyen, une batterie de 52 kWh comme celle d'une Renault Zoé reviendrait à environ 4 800 euros. Un pack neuf équivalent coûte entre 9 000 et 12 000 euros, selon l'opérateur de recharge Electra.
Pour éviter de remplacer tout le pack, on peut aussi changer seulement les modules défectueux, un service que CATL propose désormais en Norvège. Dans tous les cas, il faut ajouter la pose, réservée aux ateliers habilités à travailler sur la haute tension. Rebattex reconnaît aussi que son indice reflète l'activité de sa seule plateforme.
Le gisement reste énorme. Dans un rapport publié en septembre 2026, la société estime qu'environ 180 GWh de batteries pourraient se libérer en Europe d'ici 2035, à partir de voitures accidentées, démontées ou retirées de la route. C'est la production annuelle d'environ quatre gigafactories, un ordre de grandeur que Rebattex refuse lui-même de présenter comme une prévision officielle.
Il manque encore une donnée essentielle : ni Rebattex ni LKQ Atracco n'ont annoncé d'objectif de volume.

articles.title: Hay personas descontentas con su iPhone Duo: cuáles son las razones
articles.text:
Dos semanas bastaron para que un grupo de compradores del iPhone Duo decidiera devolver el dispositivo y recuperar los 2.000 dólares que pagaron por él. El plazo coincide con la ventana de devolución de 14 días que ofrece Apple, y que se cumplió poco después del lanzamiento del plegable. Pese a estos casos, la compañía parece mantener un ritmo de ventas estable: los nuevos pedidos en línea se proyectan para enero.
El medio The Verge contactó a varios compradores que decidieron devolver el equipo para entender sus motivos. Algunas razones resultaron previsibles para un dispositivo de primera generación: una pantalla exterior pequeña y cámaras que no destacan. Otras, en cambio, cuestionaron la propuesta central del Duo como un dos en uno.
La promesa de dos dispositivos en uno se volvió un problema
Para Ben Seligson, creador de contenido y fotógrafo, la idea de tener un iPad de bolsillo sonaba atractiva en un primer momento. Sin embargo, el uso diario reveló una desventaja: al tener un teléfono y una tableta por separado, podía dejar el iPad reproduciendo un video o un pódcast en la cocina mientras llevaba el celular en el bolsillo para responder mensajes o poner una alarma. Con el Duo, ese mismo dispositivo cumplía ambas funciones a la vez, por lo que una respuesta rápida se convertía en una interrupción mayor de lo habitual.
Fayethe Vongsouvanh, director de arte, planeaba usar el Duo para editar fotografías y organizar su boda. El segundo día de uso, la pantalla se agrietó. “En ese momento estaba en casa, en recuperación de una cirugía de mano, así que sabía que no había sido brusco con él”, relató Vongsouvanh al medio.
Obtuvo un reemplazo con rapidez, pero terminó por devolver también ese segundo equipo. El motivo principal fue el peso: “El teléfono es simplemente demasiado pesado y voluminoso para mi uso diario”, afirmó.
El arraigo al ecosistema de Apple pesa más que la curiosidad
Otro patrón entre los entrevistados fue la falta de interés en probar un plegable de Android como alternativa, no por desconocimiento del formato, sino por el peso del ecosistema de Apple en sus rutinas. Michael Hayes, otro excomprador del Duo, explicó que alternó entre Android e iOS hace una década y que todavía conserva un Pixel guardado, pero consideró que sin un cambio significativo en el mercado seguirá dentro del ecosistema de Apple.
Seligson coincidió en ese punto. Reconoció haber considerado el Galaxy Z Fold 7 de Samsung cuando se lanzó, pero el uso constante de FaceTime con su familia, sumado a su Mac y su iPad, inclinó la balanza hacia quedarse dentro del mismo sistema. Tanto Hayes como Seligson optaron por regresar a modelos de iPhone de formato tradicional en lugar de probar otros plegables.
El Duo dejó una marca en quienes lo probaron
A pesar de las devoluciones, los usuarios consultados coincidieron en que el dispositivo tuvo algún efecto en su relación con la tecnología. Seligson mencionó una particularidad que extraña del Duo: la sensación de usar algo distinto a los formatos de teléfono de la última década. Vongsouvanh, por su parte, disfrutó escribir y dibujar en la pantalla interior con el Apple Pencil, una experiencia que lo motivó a retomar el uso de su antiguo iPad Pro con un protector de pantalla tipo Paperlike.
En el caso de Hayes, la experiencia con el Duo influyó en su siguiente elección de compra: el tamaño del plegable lo llevó a inclinarse por el iPhone Pro estándar en lugar del Pro Max, que le resultó excesivamente grande después de usar el Duo.
La ventana de devolución sigue abierta para quienes reciban su equipo
Quienes aún esperan la entrega de su iPhone Duo cuentan con un margen adicional. La política de devoluciones de temporada navideña de Apple entró en vigencia el 6 de noviembre, por lo que cualquier comprador que reciba el dispositivo ahora tendrá plazo hasta el 8 de enero de 2027 para solicitar un reembolso completo. El periodista de The Verge que reportó estos testimonios indicó que continúa utilizando el Duo como su equipo principal varias semanas después del lanzamiento.

11.11: Galaxy S26 Ultra tem maior queda desde o Prime Day 2026
Galaxy S26 (256 GB) tem câmera de 200 MP e tela à prova de espiadinhas; topo de linha da Samsung atinge o menor preço em meses durante o 11.11 com cupom
O Galaxy S26 Ultra de 256 GB está saindo por R$ 6.369 com cupom 10% OFF SMARTPHONES disponível na página da Amazon. O topo de linha da Samsung, com câmera de 200 MP e nova tela AMOLED à prova de curiosos, atinge o menor preço desde o Prime Day 2026, com desconto de 45% sobre o original de R$ 11.499.
O S26 Ultra oferece performance de ponta, graças ao chip Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 For Galaxy e aos 12 GB de RAM, que sustentam apps pesados em multitarefa e recursos do Galaxy AI, conforme visto em nossos testes.
O kit principal de câmeras filma em 8K. Ele inclui wide de 200 MP com OIS e ultrawide de 50 MP, que captam belas cenas ao ar livre, telefoto de 10 MP e periscópica de 50 MP, com zoom óptico de respectivamente 3x e 5x para boas aproximações. A frontal de 12 MP tira ótimas selfies e filma em 4K.
Sua tela LTPO AMOLED Dinâmico 2X de 6,9″ traz a nova tecnologia de privacidade, que impede pessoas ao lado de espiarem o que o usuário está fazendo. A taxa de 120 Hz e o brilho de até 2.600 nits oferecem cores vibrantes, alta fluidez e visibilidade garantida.
O corpo do S26 Ultra é revestido pelos vidros Gorilla Glass Armor 2 (tela) e Victus 2 (traseira), resistentes a pancadas e quedas. A certificação IP68 confere proteção em cenários como poeira intensa e mergulhos acidentais.
Sua bateria de 5.000 mAh resiste a até 31 horas de reprodução de vídeo, segundo a Samsung. O suporte ao carregamento rápido de 60 W via USB-C e sem fio de 25 W garante o uso prolongado por um dia inteiro.
O Galaxy S26 Ultra de 256 GB (R$ 6.369 com cupom 10% OFF SMARTPHONES disponível na página) será atualizado até o Android 23 e possui conectividade 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0 e NFC.
O 11.11 é uma ação do varejo chinês, que comemora o “Dia dos Solteiros” oferecendo ofertas em eletrônicos com cupons e condições especiais. Lojas como Shopee e AliExpress trouxeram a data ao Brasil, e hoje ela faz parte da campanha da Black Friday 2026, que ocorre em 27 de novembro.

articles.title: Is this the ultimate physical media library system? Someone built a setup that uses a touchscreen and smart lights to literally show you where to find the Blu-ray you want by illuminating it, and I've never want a home upgrade more
articles.text:
Someone made Blu-ray shelves that use smart lighting to point you to the disc you want — the combination of a touchscreen library and LED strips is the coolest movie collection setup I've ever seen
The best Blu-ray setup you'll see today is an awesome, inspired and completely unnecessary way to find your favorite flicks
Wouldn't it be great if you could bring the convenience of browsing a digital movie catalog to your physical Blu-ray collection? Peter Somersby has done just that.
One of my very favorite things is when a person takes a W. Heath Robinson approach to an everyday irritation. Robinson was a cartoonist who drew incredibly complex imaginary contraptions such as the "multimovement tabby silencer", which automatically threw water at noisy cats.
Somersby's creation is actually two creations. The first, MovieNights, enables you and your friends or family to nominate films for your movie night. MovieNights then spins the wheel and eliminates each movie until only one is left; the last movie standing is the movie of the night.
That's fun. But the bit I love takes things much further and shows where the actual disc is on Somersby's shelves.
Let there be light (on your Blu-rays)
Inspired by a short from almostinventor, Somersby decided to add a touchscreen and LED lightstrips to his shelves. The result, and you need to use your movie trailer guy voice for this, is MovieShelf.
MovieShelf combines two excellent things: movies, and a shelf. As Somersby explains:
"The touchscreen shows the whole collection, with posters, search and filters. Pick a movie, and the spot where it sits lights up. Can't decide? Hit Shuffle. The shelf picks a movie and lights it up, so you just walk over and grab it. When nobody is using it, the screen runs a poster slideshow."
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
He continues: "The two apps are separate, but MovieNights can talk to the shelf. So when the TV reveals tonight's movie, the shelf lights up where the disc is, and someone walks over and grabs it." And it all runs on "a couple of Raspberry Pis and an Arduino" with some help from Claude and Codex AIs.
I genuinely love this because it's both completely unnecessary and completely brilliant. As redditor lappelduvide put it: "This is one the most unique ideas I've ever seen. Like a shower thought or dream you have a night but you turned this into reality. What an amazing concept."
What's next: a robot picker? Maybe! "I’ve definitely thought about it," Somersby says, "but it’s a big step up from LED strips. This is phase 1, so who knows what phase 2 brings :)"
Of course, if you're just looking to add discs to your shelves and not a smart lighting setup, then check out our Blu-ray Bounty series, where we test new 4K Blu-rays released every month to see which are worthy of adding to your collection. articles.title: Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt — new indiscretion comes in wake of admitted affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.text:
Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt — new indiscretion comes in wake of admitted affair with alleged Chinese spy
Huang was reportedly captured on video being affectionate with a direct report
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — already embroiled in a scandal for an extramarital relationship with a woman believed by U.S. intelligence to be spying on behalf of China — reportedly had a separate affair with one of his direct reports, according to the New York Times. Nvidia's board is now reportedly preparing to fire Huang.
The Times, citing five anonymous sources within Nvidia, says that Huang had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company's vice president of health care. The sources claim that Huang and Powell were "captured on video being affectionate" in March at a hotel in San Jose, Calif., where the company's GTC conference takes place.
That report says that someone at the hotel filmed the moment on their smartphone, but that Huang's security team "sequestered" them and "made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement."
Powell joined Nvidia in 2008 and has been steadily promoted. The Times highlights that personal relationships are mentioned as potentially causing conflicts of interest in Nvidia's code of conduct. Like Huang, she is married to someone else.
In 2018, former Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned following a relationship with an employee, which was also against the company's policies. Nvidia has not responded to a request for comment from Tom's Hardware. This story will be updated if we hear back.
Earlier this week, it came out that Jensen had an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, formerly a top executive at Singaporean firm Megaspeed and believed by U.S. intelligence to be a spy. Huang admitted to the affair in an email to Nvidia employees. China has denied claims of espionage.
Nvidia's board has an ongoing investigation into that affair, led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. Huang is continuing to run the company while that investigation is ongoing. Law firms have been racing to sue the company on behalf of shareholders, including a proposed class-action lawsuit that Nvidia misled investors on material facts about the business.
The Congressional House committee on China has called on Huang for a closed-door session, with Republican lawmakers saying the reports "raise significant national security concerns."
Huang has been a leader of the AI industry, providing the most sought-after chips in the field. He has also had the ear of President Donald Trump, traveling with him and attempting to influence export controls.
Trump told reporters that the FBI was investigating Huang, but also that the Nvidia CEO "had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy.”

articles.title: Pas besoin de jumelles pour voir le “rubis et le diamant” : Mars et Jupiter vont se frôler le 15 et le 16 novembre
articles.text:
Le diamant et le rubis : splendide rapprochement visible à l'œil nu entre Mars et Jupiter, les 15 et 16 novembre
Deux planètes, et non des moindres, vont quasiment se frôler dans notre ciel : Mars et Jupiter. Ce spectacle sera à son comble les 15 et 16 novembre et il pourra être observé à l'œil nu, au choix, aux alentours de 1h du matin ou, pour les lève-tôt, avant le lever du Soleil.
Il arrive que notre position dans le système solaire nous offre un spectacle sur mesure. Ce sera le cas les 15 et 16 novembre lorsque deux planètes donneront à l’œil nu l'impression de se toucher : Mars et Jupiter. La conjonction (c'est le nom donné à ces rapprochements en astronomie) sera visible à partir de 1h du matin, et ce, jusqu'au lever du Soleil.
Conjonction de novembre : le rubis Mars tournera autour du diamant Jupiter
Du fait de leur mouvement orbital autour du Soleil et de leur distance par rapport à ce dernier, les planètes n'ont pas toutes le même mouvement apparent pour nous, observateurs terrestres. Jupiter étant 10 fois plus loin de la Terre que Mars, la planète rouge a donc un mouvement bien plus rapide dans le ciel. Chaque nuit, jusqu'au 15 novembre, elle réduira la distance et semblera passer au-dessus de Jupiter, puis sur sa gauche.
Les amateurs d'astronomie connaissent “le saphir et la topaze”, un couple d'étoiles (bleue et jaune orangé) situé dans Albiréo, au sein de la constellation du Cygne. Cette conjonction y fait penser, d'où ce terme choisi de “rubis et diamant”, car l'éclat de Jupiter est très blanc.
Différencier étoiles et planètes : l'astuce du scintillement
Bien sûr, pour observer un tel spectacle, il faut savoir différencier les étoiles des planètes dans le ciel. Et cela tombe bien, car un détail physique trahit leur nature : en raison des perturbations de notre atmosphère, les étoiles scintillent, ce que ne font pas les planètes, ces dernières étant bien plus proches de nous.
En ce moment, la nuit, Saturne est visible (c'est la première planète à se lever), puis Mars et Jupiter suivent vers minuit. À la fin de la nuit, l'éclat puissant de Vénus fait son apparition à l'est. Mercure pointe aussi sa lumière timide juste en dessous de Vénus, peu avant le lever de l'astre du jour.
Comment bien observer la conjonction Mars-Jupiter dans le ciel ?
Il est inutile de vous munir d'un instrument complexe pour apprécier ce rapprochement : l'éclat conjugué de Mars et de Jupiter sera largement suffisant pour offrir un spectacle saisissant à l'œil nu. Cependant, si vous disposez d'une simple paire de jumelles, n'hésitez pas à la pointer vers le duo. Vous y gagnerez en relief, et vous pourrez même apercevoir les quatre principales lunes de Jupiter alignées à ses côtés, tout en admirant la nuance cuivrée de la planète rouge.
Pour ne rien rater, privilégiez une portion de ciel dégagée vers l'est et l'horizon (si vous observez vers minuit), loin de la pollution lumineuse des villes. Couvrez-vous chaudement, car les nuits de novembre savent se montrer mordantes. Ce tête-à-tête planétaire, magnifié par la compagnie de Vénus et de Saturne un peu plus loin, rappelle à quel point la mécanique orbitale sait se faire spectaculaire, offrant aux lève-tôt et veilleurs de nuit une magnifique expression de la beauté céleste.

articles.title: El DJ con IA de Spotify estrena voces en español y una opción para que deje de hablar
articles.text:
Spotify amplió las opciones de voz de su DJ impulsado por inteligencia artificial con dos alternativas en español, Nico y Fabi, dirigidas a los usuarios Premium de los mercados donde la función está disponible.
La plataforma incorporó siete voces en inglés y habilitó una opción para quitar los comentarios entre canciones.
Las nuevas voces en español provienen de México. Nico se presenta con un tono cercano y sereno, mientras que Fabi apunta a un estilo ágil y amistoso.
Ambas se suman a DJ X, la voz original de la herramienta, que combina recomendaciones musicales personalizadas con intervenciones y contexto sobre los artistas, géneros y canciones que reproduce.
La ampliación llega después de la consolidación de DJ de Spotify entre los suscriptores Premium. Según la compañía, el 80% de quienes usan la función vuelve a escucharla cada semana.
Los usuarios podrán definir qué voz prefieren desde la configuración de DJ. Asimismo, podrán desactivar los comentarios durante la reproducción para mantener una selección continua de música.
En ese modo, la aplicación solo emitirá indicaciones breves al comienzo de la sesión o cuando el oyente pulse el botón de DJ para cambiar la propuesta musical.
Nico y Fabi, las dos nuevas voces en español para el DJ de Spotify
La incorporación de Nico y Fabi amplía las opciones en español dentro de la función. Nico ofrece una presencia más pausada, mientras que Fabi propone intervenciones con un tono más rápido y con referencias anticipadas a la selección musical.
La elección de voz no modifica el sistema de recomendaciones. El DJ continúa adaptando la reproducción a los hábitos de escucha de cada cuenta, con cambios de artistas, géneros, estados de ánimo o listas sugeridas cuando el usuario lo solicita.
Spotify plantea la opción de silenciar comentarios para contextos en los que se busca una reproducción sin interrupciones, como una reunión o una cena.
La música seguirá personalizada, aunque las intervenciones habladas quedarán limitadas a los momentos de inicio y a los cambios pedidos desde la herramienta.
Spotify añadió siete voces en inglés con distintos acentos
Además de las voces en español, Spotify incorporó siete alternativas en inglés, con acentos de Estados Unidos, Australia, Reino Unido, Irlanda e India.
La lista incluye a Casey, con un tono relajado y acento del sur de Estados Unidos; Tess, de estilo directo; y Lane, con una voz juvenil y también marcada por ese acento regional. Sam representa la variante australiana, mientras que Nell suma una alternativa del Reino Unido.
Declan incorpora un acento irlandés y un perfil orientado a los seguidores de la música, mientras que Nisha ofrece una voz con acento de India. En total, la plataforma añadió nueve voces nuevas, dos en español y siete en inglés.
Cómo activar y configurar el DJ de Spotify
Para utilizar el DJ con inteligencia artificial, los suscriptores Premium deben abrir Spotify desde un dispositivo móvil y buscar “DJ” en la aplicación.
Una vez dentro de la función, el menú de tres puntos permite elegir la voz y definir si se mantienen o no los comentarios entre canciones. Después, basta con iniciar la reproducción.
Si el usuario quiere modificar el rumbo de la sesión, puede pulsar el botón del DJ. La herramienta cambiará entonces de artista, género, ambiente o conjunto de recomendaciones según el historial de escucha de la cuenta.
Qué otras nuevas funciones hay en Spotify
Además de las nuevas voces para DJ, Spotify incorporó funciones centradas en la personalización y la interacción. La compañía lanzó Music Quiz, un juego para usuarios Premium que propone preguntas sobre artistas, canciones y portadas de álbumes; su despliegue incluye mercados de América Latina en español.
Por otra parte, ahora permite excluir canciones o listas del perfil de gustos, para que no afecten las recomendaciones ni el resumen anual Wrapped.
En Estados Unidos, Taste Profile muestra cómo la plataforma interpreta las preferencias del usuario. Para familias, una configuración separa las escuchas infantiles del historial de recomendaciones.

articles.title: Black Friday : Anker fait baisser ses prix sur Amazon, de la batterie externe au chargeur GaN 140 W
articles.text:
Anker a apposé le badge « Offre Pré-Black Friday » sur ses chargeurs et batteries vendus sur Amazon, à deux semaines et demie de l’événement du 27 novembre. Nous avons retenu 7 produits, chargeurs secteur, batteries externes et station sans fil, tous moins chers aujourd’hui qu’à n’importe quel moment des 30 derniers jours.
Tous sont vendus par AnkerDirect FR, la boutique officielle de la marque sur Amazon, de 19,99 € pour le chargeur Nano II de 65 W à 99,99 € pour la station Anker Prime 3 en 1. Parmi eux figure la batterie externe que notre comparatif recommande pour les PC portables.
Les remises affichées, jusqu’à -50 %, sont calculées sur les prix conseillés par Anker. Face aux prix des 30 derniers jours, l’économie réelle va de 3 € sur la batterie Zolo 20 000 mAh à 20 € sur la station Anker Prime. Quatre produits sont détaillés ci-dessous, les trois autres complètent la liste.
Les 4 indispensables Anker du moment
Chargeur Anker 100 W à écran intelligent à 47,99 € au lieu de 59,99 €
Un chargeur à port unique pensé pour l’ordinateur portable : il reconnaît le modèle branché et propose des modes de charge destinés à préserver sa batterie, dont Anker dit qu’ils en prolongent la durée de vie jusqu’à 40 %. Il passe à 47,99 €, 12 € sous son prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours.
- 100 W maintenus : Anker annonce une puissance maximale tenue dans la durée, suffisante pour un MacBook Pro 14 pouces récent.
- Un écran de suivi : il affiche la puissance, la température et la progression de la charge, avec des mises à jour via l’application Anker Charging Manager.
- À savoir : il n’a qu’un port USB-C ; pour plusieurs appareils, le modèle 140 W à quatre ports de notre liste est plus adapté.
Station de charge Anker Prime 3 en 1 Qi2.2 à 99,99 € au lieu de 139,99 €
iPhone, Apple Watch et AirPods sur un seul socle pliable de 230 g : la station Anker Prime passe à 99,99 €, la plus forte baisse de la sélection face à son prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours (119,99 €). Elle vise les utilisateurs d’Apple qui voyagent souvent.
- Qi2.2 à 25 W : une recharge magnétique jusqu’à 25 W pour l’iPhone, avec un refroidissement AirCool annoncé à 19 dB.
- Tout est dans la boîte : l’adaptateur secteur USB-C de 45 W et un câble USB-C de 1,5 m sont fournis.
- À savoir : son chargeur de montre est certifié MFi pour l’Apple Watch, la station perd donc une partie de son intérêt hors de l’écosystème Apple.
Batterie externe Anker 25 000 mAh 165 W à 74,99 € au lieu de 99,99 €
Notre comparatif des meilleures batteries externes la retient comme la meilleure pour PC portable : elle passe à 74,99 €, 10 € sous son prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours. Ses 165 W cumulés et ses deux câbles intégrés permettent d’alimenter un ordinateur et un smartphone en même temps.
- Quatre appareils à la fois : trois ports USB-C et un USB-A, câbles intégrés compris, dont un câble rétractable de 70 cm.
- Une recharge rapide : la batterie elle-même se recharge à 100 W, selon Anker.
- À savoir : elle pèse 595 g, la plus lourde de notre comparatif, et ne propose pas de charge sans fil.
Chargeur Anker Nano II 65 W à 19,99 € au lieu de 39,99 €
Moins de 20 € pour un chargeur GaN de 65 W, capable de recharger rapidement un smartphone, une tablette ou un ordinateur portable USB-C : c’est le plus petit prix de la sélection, 4 € sous son prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours.
- Un format de poche : Anker le compare à la taille d’un étui de charge d’AirPods Pro, grâce à sa technologie GaN II.
- 65 W pour un portable : de quoi assurer la charge rapide d’un MacBook Pro 13 pouces, selon Anker.
- À savoir : seul le chargeur est fourni, sans câble USB-C, et les 39,99 € de référence sont un prix conseillé.
Les autres offres Anker du Black Friday
Batteries et chargeurs ⚡
- Batterie externe Anker Zolo 20 000 mAh 30 W (câble USB-C intégré) à 26,99 € au lieu de 34,99 €
- Chargeur Anker Zolo 140 W 4 ports à écran à 59,99 € au lieu de 89,99 €
- Chargeur Anker Nano 45 W à écran intelligent à 27,99 € au lieu de 39,99 €
VPN, logiciels, abonnements : les promos à saisir en ce moment
Chargeur, batterie ou station : lequel choisir ?
La PowerBank 25K 165 W de cette sélection est celle que notre comparatif des meilleures batteries externes, mis à jour le 13 octobre, recommande pour les PC portables, la première place revenant à l’Anker Nano Power Bank 10K. Pour un usage plus léger, la batterie Zolo 20 000 mAh à 26,99 € suffit pour un smartphone : Anker annonce quatre recharges complètes d’un iPhone 15.
Côté chargeurs secteur, tout dépend du nombre d’appareils : le Nano 45 W à 27,99 € couvre un smartphone, le Nano II 65 W à 19,99 € un ordinateur portable léger, et le modèle 140 W à quatre ports, à 59,99 €, remplace à lui seul plusieurs blocs sur un bureau. Le chargeur 100 W à écran s’adresse à ceux qui veulent avant tout ménager la batterie de leur portable.
Chargeurs, batteries et Black Friday : vos questions
Peut-on emporter une batterie externe de 25 000 mAh en avion ?
En général, oui : les batteries sont acceptées en cabine jusqu’à 100 Wh, et Anker annonce 90 Wh pour sa PowerBank 25K 165 W, comme le rappelle notre comparatif. Les conditions varient toutefois selon les compagnies, mieux vaut vérifier avant le départ.
Un chargeur de 65 W suffit-il pour un ordinateur portable ?
Pour la plupart des ultraportables, oui, d’autant qu’un chargeur GaN reste compact. Les ordinateurs plus gourmands, comme un PC équipé d’une carte graphique, tirent parti d’un modèle de 100 W ou de 140 W, comme ceux de cette sélection.
Que signifie la certification Qi2.2 ?
C’est la version la plus récente de la norme de recharge sans fil magnétique Qi2, qui porte la puissance à 25 W, contre 15 W pour la première génération. La station Anker Prime de cette sélection en bénéficie pour l’iPhone.

articles.title: Edelbyte reels in $70M for its multipurpose data analytics platform - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Edelbyte reels in $70M for its multipurpose data analytics platform
Edelbyte Ltd., the developer of a data analytics platform optimized for artificial intelligence agents, launched today with $70 million in funding.
The startup raised the capital over two rounds. The investments were led by Sequoia and Quiet Capital with contributions from Greenoaks and Swish Ventures. According to CTech, Edelbyte is valued at $500 million.
Tel Aviv-based Edelbyte was founded last year by former Microsoft Corp. executives Avner Aharoni, Evgeney Ryzhyk, Alexander Sloutsky and Yoni Leibowitz. They helped develop Azure Data Explorer, a tool for analyzing real-time information streams. Customers often refer to it as Kusto in a nod to the eponymous query language it uses to find data patterns.
The company positions its platform as an alternative to Snowflake and Databricks. It’s designed to store up to hundreds of petabytes of data per deployment. It can hold both standard records and vectors, the mathematical structures in which AI agents keep their knowledge. Vectors store not only data snippets such as product listings but also information that makes it easier to find similar items.
The platform supports a wide range of queries. A search engine can use it to find records sought by users, while a business intelligence tool can run analytics calculations. There’s also support for graph processing. That’s an analytics approach used to study data points that relate to one another in some way, for example because they were created in the same system.
Edelbyte claims that its platform can query multipetabyte datasets with under 100 milliseconds of latency. Under the hood, it uses several different optimization methods to achieve that performance .
Analyzing a dataset usually requires companies to move it to a dedicated processing environment. Edelbyte uses a technology called query federation to skip that step. Instead of requiring users to load all their data into its platform, It can run queries in the systems where the data is usually stored. It thereby speeds up processing and reduces the amount of bandwidth that must be spent on moving data between environments.
Edelbyte further optimizes queries by generating indexes. Those are collections of shortcuts that make it easier to find specific items in a large dataset. An index only works if it’s tailored to the data access patterns of the application that uses it. According to Edelbyte, its platform automates some of the manual work involved in the index customization workflow.
“The systems companies rely on to search and analyze their data were built for a world before AI,” said Chief Executive Avner Aharoni (pictured, right). “As it becomes central to how businesses operate, the volume and complexity of data queries will grow far beyond what legacy infrastructure was designed to handle. We believe this creates an opportunity to build a new market leader in search and analytics.”
Edelbyte says several Fortune 500 customers use its platform to power petabyte-scale data environments. The company will use its new funding to grow its installed base and hire more employees.

articles.title: Mounting Finished-Goods Inventories Prompt Some PC OEMs to Adjust Memory Procurement Plans for 2027
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 11th 2026
Mounting Finished-Goods Inventories Prompt Some PC OEMs to Adjust Memory Procurement Plans for 2027
More than a year of rising memory prices has placed mounting cost pressure on the consumer electronics industry, according to TrendForce's latest memory industry research. Notebook shipments, in particular, are expected to decline sharply quarter-over-quarter beginning in 3Q26, leaving PC OEMs grappling with sluggish sales and swelling finished-goods inventories. 
Against this backdrop, some manufacturers are planning to adjust memory procurement for 4Q26—and even 1Q27—while considering a greater reliance on private-label models in their shipment mix.TrendForce notes that PC OEMs brought forward some of their procurement and production schedules to the first half of 2026 in anticipation of further memory price increases. However, higher retail prices have dampened sales across Asia and Europe, while finished-goods inventories have been gradually rising among OEMs and in North American distribution channels.
Notebook shipments fell 15.8% QoQ in 3Q26, with a further single-digit percentage decline possible in 4Q26. These mounting inventory pressures are prompting some OEMs to reassess their product strategies for 2027, including plans to expand the share of private-label models while incorporating lower-specification memory chips and CPUs with fewer cores.
PC DRAM contract prices forecast to rise 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26, while client SSD price increases expected to stay below 5%
In the PC DRAM market, TrendForce observes that earlier rounds of steep price increases prompted some PC brands to place orders beyond their actual requirements. Overall, declining finished-product shipments have led to a steady increase in DRAM inventory weeks among OEMs since 3Q26, with inventories expected to build further in 4Q26. Some manufacturers have already begun renegotiating their product mix requirements for 2027 with memory suppliers.
On the supply side, robust demand from AI applications has led memory manufacturers to tentatively plan cuts to PC DRAM supply in 2027. However, suppliers have some flexibility to slightly moderate price increases because there is relatively little pressure to absorb the production capacity involved. Maintaining strategic partnerships with PC customers also remains a priority as manufacturers prepare for longer-term opportunities in edge AI. 
Against a backdrop of softening PC demand and changing supply strategies, TrendForce forecasts that PC DRAM contract prices will rise 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26, with increases slowing from the previous quarter.
A similar shift is emerging in the client SSD market, where escalating costs across the entire bill of materials (BOM) have pushed retail prices higher and dampened consumer appetite. As a result, PC OEMs have little choice but to impose strict cost controls on components such as SSDs while firmly resisting additional price increases.
PC brands have broadly curtailed client SSD procurement in 4Q26 as end-market demand remains subdued and finished-goods inventories stay at elevated levels, purchasing only what is necessary to maintain essential production schedules. This cautious approach is also extending into 1Q27, with procurement plans already being revised downward.
Meanwhile, client SSD production capacity continues to be squeezed by the growing demands of AI-related applications. Seeking to improve their product mix and production economics, suppliers are imposing steeper price increases on lower-capacity SSDs to discourage demand for these less profitable products.
In mainstream capacity segments, however, Chinese suppliers and module manufacturers have gained traction by offering comparatively modest price increases, attracting a larger share of orders. Their increasingly competitive quotations have helped soften the broader impact of higher prices maintained by other suppliers.
As a result, TrendForce expects client SSD contract prices to rise by less than 5% QoQ in 4Q26, marking a notable moderation from the previous quarter.

articles.title: La cúpula de Nvidia se prepara para destituir a Jensen Huang tras descubrirse una segunda infidelidad, según el WSJ
articles.text:
Jensen Huang ha pasado de ser quien personificaba el pegamento de la IA a convertirse en alguien que pronto podría tener que empezar a buscar un nuevo trabajo. Durante el día de ayer, las acciones de Nvidia cayeron más de un 8%, un movimiento impulsado por una exclusiva de The Wall Street Journal en la que se apuntaba que Jensen podría ser despedido tras revelarse que habría tenido una relación extramatrimonial. Otra más, queremos decir, aparte de la que ha mantenido con la supuesta espía china Alice Huang.
En este caso, y como señalan en The New York Times, con Kimberly Powell, vicepresidenta de salud de Nvidia. Y ha sido la gota que ha colmado el vaso y que ha hecho que la junta pase de un discurso de apoyo a Jensen a estar valorando su destitución.
El problema es que no hay un claro número dos para una de las compañías más importantes del planeta en estos momentos. Si no la que más.
De aventura en aventura
Todo ha escalado demasiado rápido. Hace un año supimos que una empresa llamada Megaspeed, una neocloud de Singapur, era sospechosa de pasar a China tarjetas prohibidas de Nvidia para entrenar a la IA. Posteriormente, que se estaba investigando a una directiva de la compañía y que Jensen había sido uno de los más interesados en que Nvidia vendiera a China para ganar parte de ese enorme pastel.
De hecho, insistió tanto que consiguió que Trump diera su brazo a torcer. Sin embargo, las cosas se precipitaron hace unos días cuando Jensen admitió que había sido infiel, en una carta pública colgada en el blog de Nvidia. Esa infidelidad la cometió con Alice Huang, y resulta que, desde el principio, había quien sospechaba que se trataba de una espía china.
Desde entonces, la valoración de Nvidia ha caído en picado, más que tras el jueves negro de la bolsa de tras las elecciones de la semana pasada, y la junta de la compañía ha pasado de apoyar a su CEO e iniciar una investigación paralela para descubrir hasta qué punto se había comprometido información a, como apuntó WSJ hace unas horas, estar pensando en destituir al líder.
No nos vamos a meter en cotilleos, pero básicamente, Huang y Powel fueron cazados juntos en un hotel separado al del resto de componentes de Nvidia durante la GTC de la compañía en marzo. El Times apunta que los rumores sobre un posible romance entre Jensen y su empleada lleva tiempo circulando por la compañía.
Powell no tiene experiencia en salud o ciencia, pero ostenta el cargo de "responsable del negocio de salud de la compañía en todo el mundo, incluidas las plataformas de hardware y software para computación acelerada, inteligencia artificial y visualización que impulsa el ecosistema de imágenes médicas, ciencias de la vida, descubrimiento de medicamentos y análisis de atención médica", lo que ha despertado esos rumores dentro de Nvidia.
Como decíamos, Jensen se ha convertido en uno de los hombres más fuertes del sector de la IA, liderando una transformación espectacular (para el negocio, claro) desde que cofundara la compañía en 1993. La compañía llevaba varias semanas consecutivas cayendo debido a ciertas condiciones tanto políticas como del sector, y la junta parecía al lado de un lider que no tiene sustituto aparente.
Sin embargo, el primer affair con una supuesta espía china, el remate de la segunda relación extramatrimonial con una persona que le reporta directamente y que se hayan esfumado más de 190.000 millones de dólares en un solo día son demasiados elementos como para que la junta los deje pasar, ya que todo se ha unido para hacer que Nvidia esté en una posición en la que no quiere estar.
Sólo queda esperar, pero en Bloomberg ya se señala que Nvidia está trabajando con una firma externa para buscar candidatos.
